name: Hässleholm to Eslöv, curvy roads, 10 % budget
description: The same trip with only 10 % extra time: the route must stay within it. Until 2026-09-26 the curvy detour (12 %) didn't fit and the route stayed near the fast road; with fast roads counted as dull a curvier way within 10 % is found (26 % curvy against 6 %).
